tags.chapter_name: Center of Mass Momentum and Collision

question.text: A block of mass 1 kg is pushed towards another block of mass 2 kg from a 6 m distance as shown in the figure. If just after the collision, the velocity of 2 kg block is 4 m s-1, then

options.text: Coefficient of restitution between the blocks is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn></math>
Coefficient of restitution between two blocks is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac bevelled="true"><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></math>
Coefficient of restitution between two blocks is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac bevelled="true"><mn>1</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac></math>
Coefficient of restitution between two blocks is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac bevelled="true"><mn>1</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></math>

solution.text:
From conservation of linear momentum we can see that velocity of 1 kg block just after collision is 2 m/s leftwards.





Now relative velocity of approach = 6 m/s

and relative velocity of separation = 6 m/s

e = Relative velocity of separation Relative velocity of approach = 1
